settingsCommunity.title: Public community
settingsCommunity.description: Publish selected chat channels as a public, SEO-friendly forum.

templates.title: Start from a template
templates.description: A forum with three good answers is more useful than an empty one with perfect categories. Pick a shape and we'll lay out the channels and seed the first threads.
templates.openReplies: Anyone signed in can reply and start threads
templates.premoderated: Replies and new threads are held for your approval
templates.readOnly: Read-only to start — open replies later
templates.footnote: Applying a template creates channels and threads. Nothing becomes public until you switch the community on below. Safe to click twice — channels that already exist are left alone.

enable.label: Enable public community
enable.hint: Master switch. While off, nothing is visible to the public even if individual channels are marked public.
enable.warning: Channels you mark web public — and their history from the moment you publish — become visible to anyone on the internet and may be indexed by search engines.

details.title: Forum details
details.descriptionPlaceholder: What this community is about (used as the meta description).
details.noindex: Public but not indexed by search engines (noindex)
details.listed: List this community in the public directory at /community

participation.title: Participation
participation.repliesHint: Anyone signed in to Aexy can post in public channels. When off, the forum is read-only.
participation.newTopicsLabel: Let them start new threads too
participation.newTopicsHint: Answering in a thread you started and opening one themselves are different amounts of trust. Off means visitors can only reply.
participation.moderationPre: Hold for my approval before publishing

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Publish answers you have already written elsewhere in Aexy. Both are off until you turn them on, because publishing moves text somebody else wrote onto a page anyone can read.
connections.serviceDeskLabel: Publish answers from Service Desk tickets
connections.serviceDeskHint: Adds a "Publish as community answer" action to a ticket. It opens a composer pre-filled with the answer — you edit it before anything is posted. Customer email is never published as-is.
connections.docsHint: Adds a "Discuss this page" action to a published document, opening one public thread per document.

moderation.title: Pending review ({count})
moderation.wholeThread: This opens a new thread — approving publishes its title too, and rejecting removes the whole thread.

appearance.title: How you appear publicly
appearance.description: Controls the name shown next to your messages on public pages.

toast.prefFailed: Could not save your display preference
toast.templateApplied: Created {channels, plural, one {# channel} other {# channels}} and {threads, plural, one {# thread} other {# threads}}
toast.templateNothingToDo: Those channels already exist — nothing to add
toast.templateFailed: Could not apply the template (admin required?)
toast.templateSettingsKept: Your existing participation settings were kept
